title: PD Disaggregation Dynamic P:D Ratio Sizing, Heterogeneous GPU Pairing & Cross-Node KV Bandwidth Guide (Dynamo NIXL / Mooncake / LMCache / SGLang)

workload_basis.model_cohort: Llama-3.3-70B (GQA-8, 163.84 KB/tok FP8 KV) & DeepSeek-V3/R1 671B (MLA, 35.14 KB/tok FP8 KV)
workload_basis.diurnal_traffic_mix: Daytime RAG (16K In / 400 Out, 50% Prefix Hit) + Nighttime Deep Reasoning (2K In / 4K Out)

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Homogeneous Colocated Serving (No PD Disaggregation, 16K Long-Prompt Contention)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Small clusters (<=8 GPUs) or environments lacking RDMA interconnect

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Static 1:1 Homogeneous PD Disaggregation (Fixed 16P:16D Pool without Flex Workers)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Steady single-profile traffic with unchanging Input:Output token ratio

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Heterogeneous P/D GPU Pairing (Compute-Dense H100 Prefill + Bandwidth-Dense H200 Decode + Mooncake RDMA)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Dedicated enterprise RAG/Agent clusters matching hardware SKU to compute vs. bandwidth bottlenecks

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Heterogeneous PD + 25% Elastic Flex Role-Flipping + Dynamo NIXL / SGLang Layer-Wise Pipelined RDMA
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production multi-workload AI platform (4.15x Goodput & -71.7% $/1M tokens across diurnal RAG/Reasoning swings)
